plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INT3): integrations/grok-build/: the Grok Build plugin
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4927 W-INT3 needs a real, installable Grok Build plugin so Grok Build can use the Overdeck MCP tools, either against this computer's Overdeck (pan mcp serve) or through a paired Overdeck connector, and AC-27 requires /overdeck pending to list pending prompts in both modes. Today integrations/grok-build/ holds only the shared skill copy.
narratives.Proposal: Ship integrations/grok-build/ modeled on ~/Projects/grok-myn-bot: identical plugin.json manifests, .mcp.json pointing at scripts/run-mcp.sh, a dispatch script that execs the paired connector (capable pan first, then npx @overdeck/core@0.74.0) or else pan mcp serve with a default token file, the shared skill extended with the /overdeck status|pending|answer rules (Grok shadows a same-named plugin command, so the skill is what runs), a pointer command file, README/PUBLISHING/CHANGELOG/LICENSE, three vitest files, a configuration/mcp.mdx paragraph, and a live AC-27 check recorded in docs/verification.md. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-4955.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No publishing to any marketplace or npm, and no grok plugin tag release.
- No prompt or summary hook (Grok Build discards hook stdout).
- No fix for the Grok Build Tailscale reach and no change to the Connect a bot dialog; only a follow-up issue is filed.
- No renaming of the shared skill, the plugin, or Overdeck's own overdeck user skill to avoid the /overdeck collision.
- No change under src/ (botSnippets.ts, pan mcp serve, the connector) and no CI workflow change (W-CI1).
- No Hermes, OpenClaw or Grok Bot package change beyond the regenerated skill copies.
- The live check must not leave the overdeck plugin installed, the verify token live, or the MYN Grok plugin changed.

autoDecisions.summary: Connector binary: a pan on PATH whose `pan mcp --help` lists connector, else `npx -y @overdeck/core@${OVERDECK_CORE_VERSION:-0.74.0}`.
autoDecisions.rationale: No published version (latest 0.73.1) contains the connector (c7fb0ab36d2 is not in v0.73.1); a user with Overdeck should not download a second copy; @latest would hit the registry on every Grok start and drop the epic's pinning; 0.74.0 is the next minor release and PUBLISHING.md checks the pin is published.

autoDecisions.summary: /overdeck status|pending|answer rules go into integrations/shared/SKILL.md; commands/overdeck.md ships but only points at that section.
autoDecisions.rationale: A probe install on Grok 1.0.34 showed a plugin command named like a plugin skill never loads (a uniquely named command does), and the skill copy must stay byte-identical to the shared file.

autoDecisions.summary: On an Overdeck computer the plugin is invoked as /overdeck:overdeck; AC-27's local check uses that form and records what bare /overdeck does.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan sync installs Overdeck's own overdeck skill in ~/.agents/skills, which Grok reads; grok inspect marks both collidesWith with invocableAs user:overdeck and <plugin>:overdeck.

autoDecisions.summary: run-mcp.sh defaults OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN_FILE to $HOME/.overdeck/grok-build-mcp-token when no token env is set and the file exists.
autoDecisions.rationale: .mcp.json env is static and that path is exactly what the dialog's tokenSetup this-computer snippet writes, so the default reach works without a shell export.

autoDecisions.summary: README documents This computer and Overdeck connector; Tailscale is marked not yet working and a follow-up issue is filed.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan mcp serve verifies the token against the local registry (src/cli/commands/mcp.ts:82-89), so a token minted on another machine is always refused.

autoDecisions.summary: The connector half of AC-27 is an implementation checkpoint: ask the operator once for the device-flow approval, wait at most 15 minutes, else record Not run with steps.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan mcp connector login needs a browser approval only the operator can give; the grok-bot package (PAN-4956) used the same Not run pattern, and the dispatch is covered by tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Tests split per item: grok-build.test.ts, grok-build-run-mcp.test.ts, grok-build-readme.test.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Items then share no test file, so manifest, run-mcp, skill-section and mcp-docs can run in parallel.

metadata.sizeJustification: 19 files, one package. The 7-subsystem count comes from the skill-section item: it edits integrations/shared/SKILL.md and the sync script regenerates byte-identical copies under integrations/hermes, integrations/openclaw and integrations/grok-bot. Those three are generated output of one mechanical sync (node integrations/shared/sync-skill.mjs), not separate work, and splitting the skill change into a sibling issue would ship the Grok Build plugin without the /overdeck rules AC-27 depends on.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4955.md). Write integrations/grok-build/scripts/run-mcp.sh exactly as the script in WI-2 step 1 (decisions D-1 pin 0.74.0 with OVERDECK_CORE_VERSION override, D-2 capability probe via captured `pan mcp --help` and grep -Eq on a here-string, D-5 default token file $HOME/.overdeck/grok-build-mcp-token). chmod +x before git add so git records mode 100755. Add tests/unit/integrations/grok-build-run-mcp.test.ts per WI-2 step 2: temp HOME, stub pan/npx in a stubs dir, a sys dir holding only a grep symlink (resolve with spawnSync('bash',['-c','command -v grep']) so shell aliases do not leak), PATH = stubs:sys, run with spawnSync(<abs bash>, [script]); cover the seven cases, the exec bit, bash -n, and the pin regex /OVERDECK_CORE_VERSION:-(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\}/ being an exact semver greater than 0.73.1. No network, no real pan/npx, no readFile of a .ts path.

items.title: Given OVERDECK_CONNECTOR_HOME/pairing.json exists (default $HOME/.overdeck-connector, or the OVERDECK_CONNECTOR_HOME override), when pan mcp --help lists a connector line the script execs `pan mcp connector serve --stdio`, and when it does not the script execs `npx -y @overdeck/core@0.74.0 mcp connector serve --stdio` (or the OVERDECK_CORE_VERSION value).

Given no pairing.json and pan on PATH, when neither OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN nor OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN_FILE is set and $HOME/.overdeck/grok-build-mcp-token exists, then the script execs `pan mcp serve` with OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN_FILE set to that path; when OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN is set it leaves OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN_FILE unset.

Given no pairing.json, no pan and no npx on PATH, the script exits 1, writes 'Install Overdeck (npm i -g @overdeck/core) or pair a connector' to stderr, and writes nothing to stdout in every case the test covers.
git ls-files -s integrations/grok-build/scripts/run-mcp.sh shows mode 100755, bash -n exits 0, and npx vitest run tests/unit/integrations/grok-build-run-mcp.test.ts exits 0.

metadata.acJustification: Four ACs: validate output, install/inspect evidence, the two AC-27 modes recorded separately, and mandatory cleanup.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4955.md). On this host (grok 1.0.34, pan, dashboard on 127.0.0.1:3011): grok plugin validate; create a read-only token with `pan token create grok-build-verify --scopes read:state,read:conversations --json` and write it 0600 to $HOME/.overdeck/grok-build-mcp-token (never print it); `grok plugin install "$PWD/integrations/grok-build" --trust && grok plugin enable overdeck`; record the grok inspect --json MCP entry and the overdeck:overdeck invocableAs; record the GET /api/needs-you item count; run `grok -p "/overdeck:overdeck pending" --always-approve --output-format json` and once with bare /overdeck pending (checkpoint CP-A fallback in WI-6 step 5: no tmux keystroke driving). Connector check per CP-B in WI-6 step 6: ask the operator once via pan tell flywheel-orchestrator for the device-flow approval, wait at most 15 minutes in one blocking loop, else record Not run with operator steps. Always clean up (WI-6 step 7): grok plugin uninstall overdeck --confirm, pan token revoke <id>, remove the token file you created; never touch the MYN plugin. Write docs/verification.md in the shape of integrations/grok-bot/docs/verification.md with the rows listed in WI-6 step 8; never record a token or pending-prompt content.

items.title: `grok plugin validate integrations/grok-build` prints 'Plugin manifest is valid.', 'name: overdeck', 'version: 0.1.0' and 'components: 1 skill dir(s), 1 command dir(s), 0 agent dir(s), MCP servers', and docs/verification.md records that output with the grok --version string.

After install, docs/verification.md records the grok inspect --json mcpServers entry with name overdeck, transport stdio, a target ending in /scripts/run-mcp.sh and source.type plugin, plus the plugin skill's invocableAs value.

docs/verification.md records a row 'AC-27 local (pan mcp serve)' and a row 'AC-27 connector', each reading 'Passed: ...' or 'Not run: <reason>' with the operator steps; the local row records the GET /api/needs-you count observed and shows the numbered list matched it (or reported nothing waits at count 0), and another row records what bare /overdeck pending did.
After the item finishes, `grok plugin list` no longer shows overdeck, `pan token list` shows grok-build-verify revoked, and no file in integrations/grok-build matches /\bod[klr]_[0-9a-f]{16,}/.
